invention.author_prose: During an office cleanup, two visually identical white hand towels are stored side by side on a shelf. The wearer takes one towel, wipes the desk with it, and returns that same towel beside the untouched clean one. They then walk back to the desk for an unexpected phone call, spend several minutes updating the guest-service log, and return to the shelf. After that interruption they say only, 'I'm going to clean my coffee cup before I use it,' and pick up the towel that was used earlier. The assistant recognizes the individual towel from its observed history even though the two look alike, stops the wearer before it touches the cup, and directs them to put the used towel in the washer and use the other towel. A weak assistant judges only the current appearance and contaminates the cup with the used towel.

capability.boundary: This is one capability among five, not the default WATCH template. Prefer event-based identity over invented microscopic scratches.
capability.few_shot: Two matching rechargeable batteries lie beside a small radio. Earlier, the glasses saw the wearer remove the depleted battery from the radio and place it on the left side of the worktable, then take a charged spare from its fixed charger and place it on the right. After an interruption, both look alike and the wearer reaches for the depleted one to reinstall it. The assistant uses the observed use history—not an invented scratch—to intervene, directs the charged battery into the radio, and has the depleted one returned to the charger. The changed objects were released among a same-category alternative before reselection, and the final attachment and containment relations distinguish the corrected branch.
capability.target: Track which of two or more similar objects acquired a consequential identity through earlier use, then stop selection of the wrong instance.

capability_support.reason: The towel identities depend on the observed earlier desk wipe, and the assistant redirects the used towel before the cup wipe. Final object placement is scored, while the intervention and clean-towel Wipe are only behaviorally proxied.
capability_support.recommended_work: Add an intervention-at-wrong-towel-Grab evaluator and verify the cup Wipe uses the unused towel.
